svg.text: INIT (orange): MC pushes ALL config, PHY trains, init_complete. ctrlupd (purple, MC-initiated) = MC asks a quiet window to re-push PHY cfg (e.g. post freq-change); phyupd (teal, PHY-initiated) = PHY asks to retrain, MC grants by pausing. Neither writes the other's regs directly - they hand off through the update window.
